note: Assistant classification of every review-v4 rejection of a V-L label that belongs to a discrepancy also reported as V-V (dual-labeled issue in discovery v2; linked pair in discovery v3), from the reviewer's own assessment.

categories.per_shot_reading: The requirement comes from the contract's character/object description or another shot; the reviewer rejects because the violating shot's own text does not restate it, or because another shot satisfies it.
categories.not_a_text_requirement: The V-L half rests on details the text never states (gender, exact pattern, inner layers); the rejection is correct and the V-V half carries the problem.
categories.visual_judgement: The reviewer judges the frames compatible with the requirement (viewpoint, color shade, shape still 'angular').
